evidence.quote: FibroScan ® by Echosens has been delivering fast, non-invasive insights into liver fibrosis (stiffness) and steatosis (fat) for over 25 years. || Echosens has made FibroScan ® available in over 127+ countries enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide. || Find practical resources, user support, and expert insights for healthcare professionals using FibroScan® to optimize daily clinical practice.
